structure: Independent covariate draws: sex Bernoulli(0.5); age Uniform(18,75) years; BMI Uniform(14,32) kg/m^2, all mutually independent. Outcomes are total cholesterol and HDL cholesterol generated as linear conditional means in age, female indicator, and BMI plus correlated residual shocks. Residual shocks use two independent Rademacher variables and one common Rademacher with loadings sqrt(1-rho) and sqrt(rho), so population Pearson correlation is exactly rho and each shock has variance equal to the specified residual_sd^2. Residual shocks are independent of covariates, so population OLS coefficients of the requested raw-scale adjusted models equal the specified linear coefficients. Bounded Rademacher support keeps lipids positive under the specified covariate support. No causal intervention effects are represented. Delivered units are mmol/L; the supplied conversion factor is used only for slope estimands in mg/dL. No pregnancy, HIV, diabetes, fasting, lifestyle, outlier, or TC>=HDL exclusions are imposed because the target task does not include those flags.

requested_estimands.derivation: By construction, population OLS BMI coefficient equals model_spec.joint_law.outcome_linear_models.hdl_cholesterol.bmi_coef. Therefore 5 * (-0.005 mmol/L per kg/m^2) * 38.67 mg/dL per mmol/L = -0.96675 mg/dL per 5 kg/m^2.

By construction, population OLS BMI coefficient equals model_spec.joint_law.outcome_linear_models.total_cholesterol.bmi_coef. Therefore 5 * 0.04 mmol/L per kg/m^2 * 38.67 mg/dL per mmol/L = 7.734 mg/dL per 5 kg/m^2.

By construction, the residual shocks from the two models have Pearson correlation model_spec.joint_law.residual_dependency.pearson_correlation = 0.14, and shocks are independent of the model covariates.

limitations: External sources are from Ghana, Malawi, and Uganda, not the Tukana target; all transfer to the Turkana study-protocol target is an explicit assumption.
Curator extractions are historical provenance and were not independently reauthenticated against original articles.
Agongo BMI-lipid coefficients are univariate and log-scale, not adjusted raw-scale coefficients; Greiner BMI-HDL regression scale is unresolved and context-only.
Obirikorang TC-HDL correlations are Spearman, unadjusted, and from Ashanti communities; they are not Pearson residual correlations.
Target age, sex, and BMI composition are unspecified; uniform covariate distributions and sex balance are explicit assumptions, not empirical Turkana composition.
Age and sex outcome coefficients are assumed because no direct adjusted source coefficient is supplied.
The residual distribution is an artificial bounded Rademacher factor model chosen for positivity and analytically tractable correlation, not an empirical lipid residual distribution.
The generated lipids are in mmol/L; conversion to mg/dL is numeric only and does not establish assay equivalence with the target CardioChek Plus venous-EDTA protocol.
The exact estimands are population model values, not estimates from a finite generated sample; a particular generated sample will vary around them.
Source statistics from the same manuscripts or same cohorts are dependent evidence and were not treated as independent studies.
No causal intervention effects are represented; the requested analyses are descriptive association projections from the specified joint law.
